SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. REGIS.
D. 7519
S.1, Special Branch 22/10 36
REPORT
Date October 22, 19 36.

Subject Dzu Tai Dramatic Society - meeting

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by [Signature]

Forty-two members of the Dzu Tai Dramatic Society
(時代劇社) held a meeting in their office in the Dzu Tai
Vocational School, 135 Jessfield Road, O.O.L. between 9 p.m.
and 10.30 p.m. October 21. Liu Shao-yen (劉紹賢), a
teacher of the Dzu Tai Vocational School, who is one of the
directors of the Dramatic Society, reported that this society
had arranged to stage performances in the past but they were
prohibited by the local authorities. He intimated that
certain members had given out information to the authorities,
and instructed that in future the members should keep strictly
secret and confidential all activities of the society under
pain of being expelled from the society and treated as
traitors by local public bodies.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

（左侧批注：DBR 22/10）

D. C. (Special Branch)
Keep them under
some supervision as they
obviously have undesirable
intentions

S.1.
Forwarded DBR 22/10
Noted
[Signature] Y.K. Kao
22/10/36

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 22 OCT. 1936 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

报告
日期：1936年10月22日。

主题：时代剧社——会议

由警探长高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作 转呈 [签名]

1936年10月21日晚9时至10时30分之间，时代剧社（Dzu Tai Dramatic Society，時代劇社）的四十二名成员在该社位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）135号时代职业学校（Dzu Tai Vocational School）的办公室内举行了一次会议。该校教师、同时也是该剧社董事之一的刘绍贤（Liu Shao-yen，劉紹賢）报告称，该剧社此前曾安排演出，但被地方当局禁止。他暗示某些成员向当局泄露了消息，并指示今后所有成员必须对剧社的一切活动严格保密，违者将被开除出社，并被地方公共团体视为汉奸对待。

高延根
警探长

（左侧批注：DBR 10月22日）

某种程度的监视，因为
他们显然怀有不良意图

转呈 DBR 10月22日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
S.1, Special Branch
C. E. D. 7519
Date September 19, 1936.

Subject (in full) Dzu Tai Dramatic Society will not stage performances
this evening.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by Jm Brown DS

In compliance with an instruction from the Chinese
Police, the Dzu Tai (□□) Dramatic Society, 135 Jessfield
Road, O.Q.L., has decided to cancel the proposed staging of
theatrical performances at the above address at 7 p.m.
September 19.
This proposed performance on September 19 was
postponed from September 12, which was abandoned owing to
the prohibition of the Chinese Authorities.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

(批：Chen 19/9)
(批：FILE / 282)

主题（全称）时代剧社今晚不进行演出。

由警探长高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作 转呈 Jm Brown DS

遵照中国警方的指令，位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）135号的 O.Q.L. 区时代（□□）剧社决定取消原定于9月19日晚7时在上述地址举行的戏剧演出计划。
此次原定于9月19日的演出是从9月12日推迟而来的，而9月12日的演出因中国当局的禁令而被迫放弃。

高延根
警探长

特务科主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7519
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date September 14, 1936.

Subject The Dzu Tai Dramatic Society's plan to produce theatrical
performances on September 12 fails to
materialize.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by My Action DS

The plan of the principals of the Dzu Tai (□□)
Dramatic Society to produce theatrical performances of an
anti-Japanese nature in the Dzu Tai Vocational School, 135
Jessfield Road, O.O.I., at 7 p.m. September 12, did not
materialize owing to the staging of the plays being prohibited
by the Chinese authorities.

Prospective spectators were informed that owing
to the unforeseen departure of the principal actors from
Shanghai, the performance had to be postponed until 7 p.m.
September 19.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题：时代剧社

由警探长高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作 转呈 [签名]

一个名为“时代剧社（時代劇社）”的新业余戏剧组织于1936年8月初成立。其址位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）135号 U.O.L. 区的时代职业学校。该社有来自各行各业的六十名成员。主要成员如下：
名誉主席：
黄林金（Huang Ling-ching，黃林金），时代职业学校校长。
主席：
刘绍贤（Liu Shao-yen，劉紹賢），时代职业学校教师，居住在学校内，地址为极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）135号，U.O.L. 区。
管理委员会
刘绍贤。
姜守文（Chiang Sur-wen，姜守文），时代职业学校教师，居住在校内。
殷世棠（Ying Sz-dong，殷世棠），中国联合灯泡公司（China United Lamp Co.）职员，公司地址罗勃生路（Robison Road）140号，居住于 U.O.L. 区布伦南路（Brenan Branch Road）康福里（Kong Foh Li，康福里）11号。
孙影（Sung Ying，孫影），时代职业学校初中三年级学生。
沈其生（Sung Chi-sung，沈其生），职业为教师，居住于 O.O.L. 区康纳脱路（Connaught Road）兴公里（Shing Kong Li）48号。
罗志骥（Loh Chi，羅志驥），复旦大学前学生，居住于 U.O.L. 区康纳脱路（Connaught Road）兴公里（Shing Kong Li）26号。
叶坚（Yih Chien，葉堅），时代职业学校教师，住在校内。

（左侧批注：）
9月8日
知悉并保留

Dzu Tai Dramatic Society ( 時代劇社 ) to stage
performances on September 12.

(FILE)
(批：83)

The Dzu Tai Dramatic Society, located in the Dzu
Tai Vocational School, 135 Jessfield Road, O.O.L., is
arranging to stage the following plays on the school premises
at 7 p.m. September 12 :-
(批：西 薩)
1. "Siren Sound" which refers to the alleged oppression and
killing of Mei Sz-chun who was employed in the Dah Kong
Cotton Mill, by the Japanese management (anti-Japanese in
nature).
(批：別的苦世人)
2. "Other poor Women" which relates to a female worker
taking part in the National Salvation Movement, despite
opposition from her parents. Extracts of a political
nature from the dialogue which appears in the "Kwang Ming"
Magazine, Vol. 1, Issue 6, dated August 25, 1936, are
translated as hereunder :-
a) "On the occasion of the Dragon Boat Festival, many
shops in Shanghai closed down. The situation has
become worse during the last few days. Goods which
are smuggled come from Japan. The prices of
artificial silk goods have dropped by leaps and bounds.
We will suffer a loss in disposing of the stock in
our shop."
b) "It is stated that lately there are many XX goods, most
of which are smuggled commodities. Are any of these
goods in your shop?
"There have never been XX goods. The only thing to
remember is that we should not buy them ourselves. It
is not necessary to mind the quantity".
c) "Yes, I am young and ignorant, but the Japanese are
oppressing us and want to fight with us; I ........."

时代剧社（時代劇社）将于9月12日演出。

(归档)
(批：83)

位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）135号 O.O.L. 区时代职业学校内的时代剧社，正安排于9月12日晚7时在该校校舍上演以下剧目：
(批：西 萨)
1. 《回声》，该剧涉及据称在大康纱厂受雇的杨世钧（Mei Sz-chun）遭到日本管理层压迫和杀害的事件（具有反日性质）。
(批：别的苦世人)
2. 《别的苦女人》，讲述一名女工不顾父母反对参加救国运动的故事。剧中对话的政治性摘录见于1936年8月25日出版的《光明》杂志第一卷第六期，翻译如下：
a) “端午节期间，上海许多商店关门。近几日局势更加恶化。走私货物来自日本。人造丝制品的价格暴跌。我们处理店中库存将会遭受损失。”
b) “据说最近有很多 XX 商品，其中大多是走私货。你们店里有这些货吗？
“从来没有 XX 货。唯一要记住的是我们自己不买。没必要在意数量”。
c) “是的，我年轻无知，但日本人在压迫我们，想与我们作战；我 .........”

(批：C.Y.B.W.)
